intro: The plan Austin approved on 2026-11-13 (one step at a time; each needs his go in the build thread):

steps.title: Diagnose
steps.what: per-song loss breakdown, a stem check on the missed notes of the 6 weakest songs, and the flagged takes (Najee, Burning Daylight, Just the Two of Us)
steps.status: Done 2026-11-13: 87% of missed or wrong-pitch notes are still in the stem, so the note finder is the bottleneck; about half our notes in the flagged pop bars overlap vocals (log, 2026-11-13 diagnosis)

steps.title: Note-end ear check
steps.what: Austin listens to about 100 note ends on 3 songs, to decide whether the 60 target counts note ends

steps.title: New test set
steps.what: bars from Austin's flags, 3–5 pop songs with vocals, 3 soprano songs

steps.title: E82, vocals
steps.what: check the Demucs vocal stem, MVSep Mega and the MERT judge against vocals leaking in. Mark, never hide
steps.status: Done: E82 round 3 adopted 2026-11-13 (Mega's vocal stem on every band record, marks only; ADR-0043); code merged in PR #167

steps.title: E83
steps.what: whatever steps 1–2 point to (a note-end fix, or a second fine-tune that adds R&B, pop and soprano)
steps.status: Done 2026-11-14: E83 not adopted. Neither arm beat E77 (note F1 50.9 for all three); more mostly-older jazz doesn't move the finder, so new data must be pop, R&B, and soprano

steps.title: Docs, dashboard, not-sax instrument choices
steps.what: the handbook, a static dashboard page, and which other instruments the not-sax check names
steps.status: In progress: handbook, its update script and the static dashboard done; not-sax instrument choices next

running: the overnight search for better recordings of the charts that failed the match check (`find_better_recording.py`). A thread files the winners in the morning; nothing gets filed without a passing line-up.
waiting: Step 2 ear check when it's ready.
Which note F1 the 60 target means: with note ends or without.
Filosax dataset access: if Zenodo hasn't answered by about 11-14, send the drafted email.
